questions.prompt: Which Italian city-state was ruled by the Medici family?
questions.fact: They began as bankers, and their funding of artists is much of why the Renaissance happened where it did.

questions.prompt: What is the name for an atom with a different number of neutrons?
questions.fact: Carbon dating works by measuring how much of one unstable version remains in organic material.

questions.prompt: Which country's team is nicknamed the All Blacks?
questions.fact: The name may have come from a printer's error, with all backs misread as all blacks in a match report.

questions.prompt: Which social platform is built around short vertical videos?
questions.fact: It grew out of a merger with a lip-syncing app that already had tens of millions of users.

questions.prompt: Which country's largest city is Ho Chi Minh City?
questions.fact: It is still widely called Saigon in everyday speech, including by the airport's own international code.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character named Boo Radley?
questions.fact: He appears in person only at the very end, having been present in the story's imagination throughout.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym LED's successor OLED add?
questions.fact: Because each pixel makes its own light, switching one off produces genuine black rather than dark grey.
